summary: App.tsx adds state and handlers for a final-slide Yes/No interaction and swaps final-slide content based on clicks, but the diff is truncated before the JSX that would prove the buttons are rendered/hidden per acceptance criteria. The “Yes” follow-up message includes a similar phrase but not the exact required casing. Additional unrelated changes/files were introduced.

missing_requirements.requirement: On the final carousel slide in `frontend/src/App.tsx`, render two CTA buttons: "Yes" and "No" within the message card area when `currentMessageIndex` is on the last message (index 3).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows state (`finalSlideState`) and click handlers, but the provided snippet is truncated before the render area where the buttons would appear, so there is no direct evidence that both buttons are actually rendered on the last slide within the card.

missing_requirements.requirement: Clicking "Yes" must replace the final slide content with a thank-you loving message that includes the exact phrase "you are forever mine".
missing_requirements.reason: The "yes-accepted" text contains "You are forever mine," (capital Y) rather than the exact required phrase "you are forever mine" as written.
evidence: frontend/src/App.tsx (yes-accepted text: "You are forever mine, and I am forever yours.")

missing_requirements.requirement: After clicking "No", show a message that selecting No is not a real choice and then re-display only the "Yes" option (do not continue to show the "No" button).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows the "no-rejected" message content is set, but the snippet is truncated before the JSX that would conditionally hide the "No" button and show only "Yes", so there is no direct evidence of the required button-visibility change.

missing_requirements.requirement: Use English for any user-facing text.
missing_requirements.reason: User-facing titles include emoji characters (e.g., "Forever Yours! 💕", "Nice Try! 😊"), which may violate the English-only text constraint.
